story.iWant: to log my actual account balances over time
story.soThat: I can track real progress against my chosen strategy projections

tasks.task: Implement date selector with today default
Implement notes field for variance explanation
Write unit tests for useProgress hook
Write integration tests for snapshot flow
Verify build and all tests pass

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Given I have accounts and a selected strategy, when I navigate to the Track page, then I see a "Log Balances" section with a date selector that defaults to today.
Given I'm on the Track page, when I view the Log Balances section, then I see a list of all my debt accounts with current balance input fields pre-populated with their last known balances.
Given I'm on the Track page, when I view the Log Balances section, then I see my flexi facility (if exists) with a balance input field.
Given I have entered balances, when I click "Save Snapshot", then a BalanceSnapshot record is created in Dexie for each account with the selected date.
Given I save a snapshot, when the save completes, then a success toast confirms "Balances logged for [date]" with SA date format (DD/MM/YYYY).
Given I want to document variances, when I'm logging balances, then I can add an optional notes field explaining variances (e.g., "Unexpected car repair").
Given I enter an invalid balance (negative number), when I try to save, then validation prevents save and shows error message.
Given I have previously logged snapshots, when I navigate to the Track page, then I can see a list of recent snapshots with dates and total debt amounts.
Given I want to edit a snapshot, when I click on a recent snapshot, then I can modify the balances or notes and save the update.
Given I want to delete a snapshot, when I click delete on a snapshot, then a confirmation dialog appears, and upon confirmation the snapshot is removed.

docs.doc: Defines BalanceSnapshot interface, UseProgressReturn hook interface, Balance Logging Flow (10 steps), and variance calculation logic. Key performance target: snapshot save < 200ms.
Defines Dexie schema with balanceSnapshots table, project structure, naming conventions, error handling pattern (Result type + Toast), and logging strategy.
FR32: "User can log actual debt account balances on weekly or monthly basis" - Core requirement for this story.
Defines UX flow for progress tracking. Uses shadcn/ui Card, date picker with SA format, currency input with ZAR formatting, toast notifications for feedback.

constraints.constraint: All calculations client-side using big.js for precision - no floating-point math
Store monetary values as strings (e.g., "1234.56") for big.js compatibility
Store dates as ISO strings (YYYY-MM-DD) for Dexie indexing
Display dates in SA format (DD/MM/YYYY) using formatDate utility
Display currency in ZAR format (R 1 234,56) using formatCurrency utility
Use React Hook Form + Zod for form validation
Use Result type for hook error handling, toast for user feedback
Snapshot save must complete in < 200ms (async Dexie writes)
Use Dexie transaction for atomic multi-account saves
Input validation: balance must be non-negative (Zod schema)
Notes field: max 500 characters, sanitize HTML for XSS prevention
Components in src/components/tracking/, hook in src/hooks/useProgress.ts
Types in src/types/tracking.ts (may need to create)

tests.standards: Vitest for unit and integration tests. React Testing Library for component tests. Follow existing patterns from tests/ folder. Use fake-indexeddb for Dexie mocking. Test coverage should include happy path, validation errors, edge cases (no accounts, empty balances). Mock date-fns for deterministic date testing.
